findings.controlFlow: Cold game enters Start (index 0), clears variables, then GT main_menu. main_menu checks warning_pass before rendering. After accepted warning, main_menu renders menu first, then GS start_refresh and returns to initialization. GS start_refresh in Start before GT main_menu would set warning_pass=1 before the warning check and run the expanded reset twice. Document Quick_Start branch and location do not exist in current WORK.

It is not a pure common-settings helper. KILLALL clears all variables and objects; GS does not become GT or change CURLOC.

findings.dependencyOrder: refresh_database loads #static_base first, then #static_txt and other bases; #var_base precedes #txt_man/#txt_2_man because they consume conditional/interpolated strings. Moving #var_base to the top or bottom changes its dependency order. #static_base lines 477 and 502 are inside deferred code values $swap_slave_instances (452-480) and $clear_slave_instance (482-509); they are not extra immediate calls merely because text search finds them.
